about: Hand-checked classification cases for ScopeGuard. Each case gives an agreement, a client message and the expected verdict for every request. 'traps' are mistakes that would cost the freelancer a client (false extras) or money (missed extras). Case 01 is the acceptance test used in the README.

expected.request: Concept B with concept A's font

traps: Counting the two revisions as two rounds
Calling social sizes extra when the proposal is silent

cases.agreement: 5-page marketing site (Home, About, Services, Blog index, Contact). 2 revision rounds. Content supplied by client. $3,000.
cases.message: Can we add a Pricing page? Also the contact form isn't sending emails on mobile.
traps: Charging for a bug in the developer's own work

cases.agreement: One 90-second promo video, 16:9, 2 revision rounds, licensed music included.
cases.message: Love it! Could you make the logo animation faster and also export a 9:16 version for Reels?
traps: Treating a new aspect ratio as a revision

cases.agreement: Website copy for 4 pages, up to 600 words each. 1 round of edits.
cases.message: Can you also write the meta descriptions for each page?
traps: Calling it extra without asking: the agreement neither includes nor excludes meta descriptions

cases.history: Two rounds of feedback already done.
cases.message: Last thing, promise! Can the date be bigger and the background lighter?

cases.agreement: 3 concepts; once a concept is chosen it's locked, then 2 revision rounds on it.
cases.history: Client chose concept B in writing on 10 Nov.
cases.message: Actually, can we go back to concept A instead?

expected.evidence: once a concept is chosen it's locked

traps: Treating a switch back to a rejected concept as a revision

cases.agreement: 12 Instagram posts per month including captions and hashtags, scheduled in Later.
cases.message: Can you add hashtags to next week's posts and schedule them for 6pm?
traps: Any extra verdict here is a false extra

cases.agreement: 2 UGC videos, organic use on the brand's own channels for 3 months.
cases.message: These are great, we'd like to run them as paid ads for the next 6 months.

expected.evidence: organic use on the brand's own channels for 3 months

traps: Missing that paid-ads rights and a longer period are both outside the agreement

cases.agreement: Client provides final copy by 1 Dec. Copy changes after build start are billed hourly.
cases.history: Pages were built with the final copy supplied on 1 Dec.
cases.message: We rewrote the About page text, can you swap it in and adjust the layout to fit?

expected.evidence: Copy changes after build start are billed hourly

cases.agreement: None written. The user says: 'we agreed on WhatsApp: 2 hours, 30 edited photos, $400'.
cases.message: Can we get all the RAW files too?
traps: Stating a firm verdict without flagging that the agreement is unwritten

cases.agreement: Version 1: 3 concepts, 2 rounds, no packaging. Version 2 (approved 5 Dec by email): adds cake-box design for $150.
cases.message: Can you tweak the box colour to match the logo pink?

expected.note: judged against version 2, where the box is in scope

traps: Judging against version 1 and calling it extra

cases.agreement: Monthly retainer: 2 strategy calls (60 min) and email support Mon-Fri. No implementation work.
cases.message: Can we add a third call this month, and can you set up the HubSpot workflows we discussed? Also quick question on pricing tiers by email.
